typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ToReconControl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		MODIFIED_USER as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		RATESMOEMAIL as string,
		BOOK as string,
		BOOK_ID as integer,
		COUNTERPARTY as string,
		UPDATED_DATE as timestamp,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		DESK_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetCalypso
GetCalypso sink(input(
		MODIFIED_USER as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		RATESMOEMAIL as string,
		BOOK as string,
		BOOK_ID as integer,
		COUNTERPARTY as string,
		UPDATED_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		DESK_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MODIFIED_USER,
		PRODUCT_TYPE,
		RATESMOEMAIL,
		BOOK,
		BOOK_ID,
		COUNTERPARTY,
		UPDATED_DATE,
		SALES_PERSON,
		TRADE_ID,
		TRADE_STATUS,
		DESK_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($ToReconControl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ToReconControl
